title: Towards Realistic Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantification for LLM-Based Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.33036v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for recommendation systems. However, their issued rankings require reliable instance-level uncertainty monitoring. In this scenario, comparing uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods becomes challenging because LLM rankers lack a standard item-classification head. Their scores may depend on option labels, prompts, generation procedures, and the available user and item evidence. Existing methods derive uncertainty from different sources and apply it at different stages of the recommendation process. Some methods evaluate an issued ranking, whereas others use uncertainty to change the ranking itself, making direct comparison difficult. Here we introduce a fixed-ranking benchmark which evaluates eight heterogeneous UQ signals as record-level monitors under a shared output contract. translated_title: 迈向基于大语言模型的推荐系统中不确定性量化的现实评估
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）为推荐系统提供了灵活的接口。然而，其给出的排序结果需要可靠的实例级不确定性监控。在这种场景下，比较不确定性量化（UQ）方法变得具有挑战性，因为LLM排序器缺乏标准的物品分类头。其打分可能依赖于选项标签、提示词、生成过程以及可用的用户和物品证据。现有方法从不同的来源提取不确定性，并将其应用于推荐过程的不同阶段。一些方法评估已生成的排序结果，而另一些方法则利用不确定性来改变排序本身，这使得直接比较变得困难。本文引入了一个固定排序基准，在共享的输出契约下，将八种异构的UQ信号作为记录级监控器进行评估。我们在四个推荐数据集和两个LLM骨干网络上，在共享的…（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个固定排序基准，在统一的输出契约下将八种异构的不确定性量化信号作为记录级监控器进行评估，从而首次实现了对基于LLM的推荐系统中不确定性量化方法的公平、现实的可比性评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a fixed-ranking benchmark that evaluates eight heterogeneous uncertainty quantification signals as record-level monitors under a shared output contract, enabling fair and realistic comparison of UQ methods for LLM-based recommender systems.
